desc: extract ATSC A/52 audio from a MPEG stream.
r: extract_a52 - extract ATSC A/52 audio from a MPEG stream.

`extract_a52' extracts ATSC A/52 audio from a MPEG stream. Input is from stdin if no file is given.

-h
display help
-s track
set track number (0-7 or 0x80-0x87)
-t pid
use transport stream demultiplexer, pid 0x10-0x1ffe
